crossRefs.note: Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God, because of the reproach of…
How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
“Now therefore, what do I do here,” says Yahweh, “seeing that my people are taken away for nothing? Those who rule over…
When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned my holy name; in that men said of them, ‘These are…
“Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person…
For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.
if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,
My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
“I have only chosen you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”
But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

translations.web: However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to Yahweh’s enemies to blaspheme, the child also who is born to you will surely die.”
translations.bsb: Nevertheless, because by this deed you have shown utter contempt for the word of the LORD, the son born to you will surely die.”
translations.kjv: Howbeit, because by this deed thou hast given ➔ great occasion to the enemies of the LORD to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die.
translations.asv: Howbeit, because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of Jehovah to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die.
